text_block_list.name: ユニ
text_block_list.text:
ふむ、
今回の学びもいよいよ終演か……
色々あったが、
いざとなれば名残り惜しいものだ。
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむ、
今回の学びもいよいよ終演か……
色々あったが、
いざとなれば名残り惜しいものだ。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Hey, listen, {0}-senpai! After the ceremony stage, when I found Aoi-chan and called out to her, her first response after a long time was "eep"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと{0}先輩、
聞いてくださいよ！
セレモニーステージの後アオイちゃん見つけて声かけたら、
久々再会の第一声が
「ひっ」
なんですよ！

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Chieru's pressure on her when they met after so long must've been tough for her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
久々再会でチエルの圧は、
そりゃあの子にはしんどみでしょ。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: But even so, she came all this way. Since she didn't reply to the invitation, I thought she might be busy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
とはいえ、
はるばるよく来てくれたものだ。
招待状に返信がなかったゆえ、
彼女も多忙なのかと思っていたが。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Yeah, she was caught up with guild work, and whether she could come or not was uncertain. Well, in the end, it seems Hatzune took her place.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーね。
ギルドの仕事カブってて、
行けるかどうか微妙だったみたいよ。
まあ、
結果そっちはハツネが代わってくれたみたいだけど。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: By the way, I also exchanged greetings with Mimi-kun after a long time. "You're amazing for doing your best with the older sisters," she said, patting my head. Muhuhu.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちなみに、
ミミ君らにも久闊を叙したのだがね。
「年上のお姉さんたちと一緒にがんばっててえらいねー」
と
ぼかあ頭を撫でられてしまったよ。
もほほ。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Senpai, the little ones still think Yuni-chan is 8 years old, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
パイセン、
まだあの子らに
ユニちゃん８歳だと思われてたンすね。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Oh well, many people came to support us, and the Nakayoshi Club is the Club of Happiness.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやあ、
色んな人が応援に来てくれて、
なかよし部はしあわせ部ですね。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: That's right. The Yuni-chan's are the Happiness-chan's.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうですね。
ユニちゃんズはしあわせズですね。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Maria seems to have given up on trying for now, right? This time too, it seems like things went well. All's well that ends well, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
マリアもとりあえずは諦めてくれたみたいだし？
コレもう今回は上出来なんじゃないの。
めでたしめでたし、
つって？

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Honestly, at the time when disbandment was looming, I wasn't thinking about that at all.
text_block_list.orig_text: ぶっちゃけ解散の危機でそれどころじゃなかったですからね。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Mother, you're really using this opportunity to go back on your promise, aren't you? I'll have to confront her about this, I won't let it slide. I'll storm into the staff room.
text_block_list.orig_text:
マザーめ、
どさくさに紛れて約束を反故にする気だな。
これは問い詰めねばなるまい、
職員室へ殴りこむぞ。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: Everyone, take up arms! Charge! Ohhh...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
諸君、
武器を取れ！
突撃ぃー！　
ほあああぁぁぁ……！

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Teacher! Is a banana considered a weapon?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
先生ー！　
バナナは武器に含まれますかー！

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Haha, so let's just maintain the status quo for now?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ウケる、
とりま現状維持ってカンジ？

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: {0}, thanks for everything. Well, let's just say, take care from now on. I don't really know, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}も色々あんがとね。
ま、
これからもヨロタノってことで。
知んないけどさ。
